title: Chapter 87: The Final Battle Of The Camps (Part 3)
content:
Chapter 87: The Final Battle Of The Camps (Part 3)

From Wu Qing's point of view, without the continued participation of the Zerg, it is really difficult to say who will win and who will lose in this decisive battle of factions.

The Tengu clan, which had taken such a huge advantage, actually had an increasingly smaller advantage as the battle continued. If the battle continued, the strength of both sides would probably be almost the same.

This also shows that in this world, the army of the evil god camp will indeed have a great advantage in fighting against the armies of the native races.

Fortunately, the Tengu clan's luck is not over. With the Zerg being a variable, the Tengu clan will at least not lose in this battle.

But it's hard to say whether the emergence of the Zerg is a good or bad thing for the Tengu clan.

Seeing that it was getting late, both sides had very few troops left, and they had already thought of a temporary truce. The Zerg army was no longer waiting, and suddenly came out from behind the evil god camp army!

This turn of events surprised the commanders on both sides of the war.

The high priest of the evil god camp did not expect that the believers of the alien god who had sent so many troops to encircle and suppress such a large army would actually come here!

It can be imagined that the more than 100,000 troops in the rear must be in danger. The addition of such a powerful hostile force made their situation very bad.

The Tengu clan did not expect that the intelligence brought back by the scouts showed that the army of the Independent Territory Alliance, which was in a difficult situation and was almost annihilated, would actually have so many troops coming out from behind the evil god's camp!

Does this mean that the Independent Territory Alliance, a small alliance that they don't pay attention to, now has the strength to win or lose in a decisive battle between the left and right camps?

This made them happy, but also a little more vigilant, feeling that this independent territory alliance would eventually become a big trouble for the Tengu clan.

But now is not the time to consider this issue. With the unexpected reinforcements from the Independent Territory Alliance, if the Tengu clan works harder, they hope to completely defeat the evil god camp army today and win this decisive battle.

With this victory, the Tengu clan's Endless Mountains branch will gain great benefits, and they will have hope of regaining their lost territory.

After understanding this, the Tengu clan's army, which had originally intended to retreat, regrouped and launched an even more violent attack.

The Zerg army swept through the small forces of the Evil God camp on the periphery of the battlefield and rushed to the main formation of the Evil God army. Five thousand Hydralisks took the lead in launching a long-range attack on the Evil God army.

The main formation of the evil god's army is all powerful units such as bugbears, and there are also some special units such as giants. They are all very powerful.

Almost all the weaker racial units were consumed in previous battles.

Facing the attack of 5,000 Hydralisks led by 25 one-star Hydralisks, these well-equipped and powerful units were also unable to withstand the attack, and were rapidly reduced in number in the violent storm of continuous spike attacks.

The scene of battlefield sacrifice reappeared, and all the enemies killed by the Zerg turned into light and disappeared.

"It's the believers of the alien gods! Destroy them!"

Several phalanxes of evil god armies turned around and charged towards the Zerg army. Their long-range attack weapons had been exhausted in previous battles.

Thirty thousand Zerg puppies guard around the Hydralisk, patiently waiting for the Hydralisk to cause maximum damage to the enemy.

When the enemy paid a huge price and finally rushed in front of the Hydralisk, these puppies swarmed forward. Thirty thousand Zerg charged at the same time, breaking the Zerg record in this world.

Under the terrifying insect tide, no matter how the enemy struggles, they cannot escape the fate of being submerged!

"The army of the Independent Territory Alliance launched a strong attack!"

"Send all your backup forces to me!"

"Don't waste your luck and energy! Try to defeat them all at once!"

Gou Hong, who was originally decrepit, seemed to be rejuvenated at this time and began to issue combat orders personally.

Now he finally saw the hope of victory. Originally, even if the Evil God's camp did not have enough troops, the Tengu clan was not sure of victory. After seeing such a ferocious Zerg army, he knew that the chance of victory had truly come!

With the clan elder's personal order, the elite troops of the Tengu clan no longer conserved their strength, and the lords no longer stingy with their luck and energy, and began to attack with all their strength.

The army of the evil god's camp faced fierce attacks from two directions. Even if the soldiers were all brave and fearless, they were unable to reverse the situation.

"The army of believers in the alien gods has become powerful. Without them as a variable, there is no chance of winning this battle!"

"Get ready to retreat. If there is such a force of Ability God believers in this area, the dog clan will not have an easy time in the future!"

"We must focus on this force of Aberrant God believers in the future!"

The gray-bearded Bugbear High Priest said to a group of Bugbear Priests around him.

"Yes! Great Priest!"

The priests responded respectfully.

"Go get ready!"

Under the orders of the high priest, many bugbear priests began to consume a large amount of faith energy. Powerful faith blessings with fatal side effects, such as madness, were constantly sprayed on the various ethnic groups of the evil god's army.

"roar……!"

"Ouch...!"

"hold head high……!"

Various roars that seemed to be losing their minds could be heard from the evil god's army. This was the last struggle of the evil god's army.

"All the luck energy has been used! Strengthen the defense!"

"The evil god's camp is struggling to the death and is about to be defeated!"

The Tengu clan had a countermeasure to deal with this situation. The attacking troops immediately switched to full-scale defense, and all kinds of luck blessings also became defense blessing capabilities.

As long as they persisted for a period of time, those seemingly powerful soldiers of the evil god camp would either die or collapse on the ground, and be slaughtered.

The Zerg also had experience in dealing with it. The flexible puppies dodged left and right, and output from time to time, making those big guys who had strong attack power but seemed to have lost their minds dizzy. The power they gained by consuming their lives was basically consumed in vain.

The soldiers of the evil god camp who received the blessing of faith were similar to the frenzied bear goblins. They became larger, stronger, and their attack power increased greatly, but their speed and flexibility decreased to a certain extent. It was very difficult to attack the puppies who were deliberately dodging.

The battlefield fell into a stalemate. The bear goblin high priest led many priests who completed the task, and evacuated the battlefield and headed east under the escort of a team of about 2,000 bear goblin cavalry.

The bear goblin cavalry guarding the high priest were very special. They were fully armored, holding silver maces in their hands, and hanging metal chain hammers for throwing behind them.

Their mounts were no longer giant lizards, but a kind of beast mount that was somewhat similar to the dinosaurs that Wu Qing knew.

These cavalrymen were fierce, and Wu Qing could feel that they were not ordinary cavalrymen.

Wu Qing asked Meng through the insect man clone, and then he knew that these were the ground dragon cavalry of the bear goblin clan, the real elite troops of the bear goblin clan, and the knights and ground dragon mounts were at least one-star strength.
